counting_rule: Full regressions and independent runs overlap and are never summed. The original storage union is 69 identities per MySQL version (67+1+1). Final migration coverage is 92 distinct identities: 69 original, five new native timeout, 16 CLI timeout/cleanup units and two digest deadline units. The six-case watchdog report includes one existing CLI case; conversion/collation rechecks add no identities. The architecture rule is separate.
full80_resolution: Original full run retained one absolute-import architecture failure. Final architecture gate passed separately in both environments after repair; original XML/log is not represented as all-green.
full84_skips: Eight original skips lacked QS_AI_SCHEMA_TEST_SERVER at process startup: four query-plan cases and four owned-DDL recovery cases. All are mapped above to passing final independent cases. Later environment-file repair did not alter the running process.

schema_alignment.action: After each full suite completed, rename nine equivalent FK support indexes; all 54 non-primary indexes retain the same columns and use idx_/uk_ names.
schema_alignment.mq_fixture_alignment: Only qs_ai_mq_refactor_test and mq_dual_ai: same nine index renames and two missing Prompt signed-range checks, then complete final require_schema passed.

interoperability.grpc_and_mq_go_probes: 53 passed in earlier isolated run; overlapping full-suite coverage is not added to totals
interoperability.evidence_scope: Process fault and payload probes preceded final index-name and signed-check fixture alignment; protocol, host transaction and wire behavior were unchanged. The aligned final schemas passed complete structural validation.

retention.journal_private_backup: Retain original column collation map and journals after archive cleanup; full rollback converts all current active facts
retention.stable_forward_journal: Before rollback or cleanup preserve the latest complete switched/cleaned forward journal as an independent private backup with mode 600. Retain it after archive expiry. If reverse exchange did not occur and current writers resume, use that stable copy with --inherit-journal and fresh target/archive/journal identities in a new window; never edit phase or old stopped_at.

log_policy: Only artifact names and SHA256 digests are retained here. No DSN, credentials, private keys, raw model content or message body is copied into this document.

final_boundary_units.count_rule: 16 CLI timeout/cleanup cases and two digest deadline cases; the separate architecture rule is not a migration case. digest-deadline.xml is a prior rerun of these same two identities.

final_migration_case_union.scope: The 74 storage/native case identities passed on both isolated MySQL versions. The 18 database-independent units passed in final-boundary.xml. All case identities are counted once; full suites overlap and are not added.

watchdog_boundary: At deadline, the supervisor first attempts KILL CONNECTION only for this CLI owned connection on the same instance/account, then cancels and invalidates it. Query, insert/lock, metadata-lock RENAME, COMMIT/journal safety and expired pending actual-structure probes are scoped local evidence. Writers remain stopped and deployment locks held on timeout or unknown exchange; no blind RENAME retry or automatic old-image restoration.
